halves.name: Open-Book Golden Retriever
halves.desc: You love out loud: warm, gentle, all in, and mostly by your own rulebook.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared.
You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: Chill Personified
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, and you like the flow familiar.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You'll break any rule for your people, except the one where you tell them what hurt.
You're not unambitious. Nothing has been worth the grind yet.
hearts: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Bends rules for good reasons
tags.heart: I look at the person, not the form.
tags.sting: You think people made the rules, so the rules should bend for people.

youToldGenii.said: Worked around it quietly. Nobody got hurt.
Let it slide. They haven't won a single round all night.
The friend having the awful month. They need tonight.

tags.name: Writes the birthday paragraph
tags.heart: If I feel it, you're going to read it.
tags.sting: You'll write them five paragraphs. Helping them move is a separate negotiation.

youToldGenii.said: Invented a clash. Sent a very long, very sweet message instead.
Three paragraphs and a heart. "Read when ready."
Make them a playlist with a note on every song.

tags.name: Family's backup battery
tags.heart: When my people need someone, I want it to be me.
tags.sting: You're everyone's plan B. Your own plan A keeps moving to next month.

youToldGenii.said: A relative's errand sitting on your to-do list
Say 'I've got it' before anyone else can answer.
Bank. Open 24/7. No questions, no lecture.

tags.name: Runs it by the family group chat
tags.heart: My family is part of my 'we', and I like it that way.
tags.sting: Your big decisions need a family vote. You pretend they're just 'updates'.

youToldGenii.said: Sent a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.
A family group chat you actually reply in
Deal. Free help and home-cooked dinners nearby.

tags.name: Writes my own house rules
tags.heart: No script is the gift I gave myself.
tags.sting: You have no opinion on how others live. You have lots of opinions on how you'll live.

youToldGenii.said: A holiday you now celebrate your own way
Same energy. Mine could run that way too.
Something nobody's done: a hike, a game night, a beach.

calls.line: You've said 'technically' and then done the nice thing anyway.
Your birthday posts need a 'see more' button.
You're the one the family calls when the wifi breaks.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Nothing to hide, no harm done.’ Last time, you did: ‘Read receipts switched off’
